note: Tahoe National Forest campground on Marysville Road on the southeast side of New Bullards Bar Reservoir, about half a mile from the Dark Day boat ramp. Shaded paved sites in conifer and hardwood forest; the reservoir's sides are steep, so shore access is mostly at the ramps. Bears frequent the area. --Claude
